title: Classica
shortDesc: Amarr's flagship carriage collection — over 100 authentic-looking carriage house designs stamped in steel.
description:
Classica is Amarr's signature carriage house collection and one of its most popular residential doors. With over 100 authentic-looking carriage house designs stamped directly into steel, you get the handcrafted look of a swing-open carriage door with the convenience of a modern sectional.

Insulated steel construction keeps the garage comfortable and quiet, while a wide range of panel designs, window styles, and two-tone color combinations makes it easy to match your home's character.

title: Hillcrest
shortDesc: Steel carriage house designs at a great value.
description:
Hillcrest brings carriage house style within reach, offering steel carriage designs at a great value. It's a smart pick for homeowners who want the charm of a carriage door without the premium price.

Available in a variety of recessed and raised panel designs with multiple color and window options, Hillcrest pairs curb appeal with durable, low-maintenance steel.

title: Lincoln
shortDesc: No better value in a classic, low-maintenance steel garage door.
description:
The Lincoln collection is Amarr's classic traditional steel door and one of the best values in the lineup. Clean short- and long-panel designs suit almost any home, and the low-maintenance steel construction keeps things simple for years.

Choose from a range of colors and window options to personalize the look while keeping costs down — a dependable everyday door.

title: Olympus
shortDesc: High R-value and lasting style with superior energy efficiency.
description:
Olympus is built for energy efficiency, delivering a high R-value and lasting style for homeowners who want to keep the garage — and the rooms above and beside it — more comfortable year-round.

With traditional long- and short-panel designs, a variety of colors, and window options, Olympus combines strong thermal performance with the clean, timeless look homeowners expect.

title: Heritage
shortDesc: Enduring style in heavy-duty, low-maintenance steel.
description:
The Heritage collection offers enduring, traditional style in heavy-duty, low-maintenance steel. It's a straightforward, durable door that holds up to daily use and the elements.

With flush and raised panel designs plus a selection of colors and window options, Heritage is an easy, cost-effective way to refresh your home's curb appeal.

title: Vista
shortDesc: Clean, simple lines and a full-view design in a contemporary aluminum-and-glass door.
description:
Vista is Amarr's contemporary full-view door, built around clean, simple lines and expansive glass. Aluminum rails and full-view glass flood the garage with light and give modern homes a sleek, architectural edge.

Multiple glass options and anodized or painted finishes let you tailor the look, making Vista a standout for contemporary builds and indoor-outdoor spaces.
